notes: 23 looks for Ervo: Royal, Detective, Explorer, Scientist, Wizard, Ninja, Samurai, Pirate, Pilot, Athlete, Soccer, Musician, Chef, Artist, Holiday and more, all cut out clean
Your home-screen icon follows Ervo's look. On iPhone, the icon you add to the home screen uses the look you had picked
Ervo for Business thinks like a business: Ideas are about customers, billing, taxes, suppliers, team and renewals, shaped by what your company does. No dentist appointments here
Business Psyche: what Ervo learns in Business is about the company (products, policies, customers, finance, tools, schedule, team), kept apart from your personal Psyche
Co-owners: the owner can make an employee a co-owner, with everything the owner can do except removing co-owners or the owner
An employee whose access was removed sees why when they open Ervo, and can rejoin with a new ID
How Ervo Works reads differently in Business; Reset asks twice; the Switch row sits at the top of Settings
New looks are easy to add: a picture and one line in looks.json (animated ones welcome)
One email, two Ervos: the same sign-in can have Ervo Personal and Ervo for Business, each with its own chats, Psyche, activity, settings and notifications. Switch between them in Settings
Real sign-in: Ervo now sends a 6-digit code to your email. Anyone who had a preview account signs in again once
Ervo for Business teams: pick Company or Employee when you sign up. Owners create employee IDs; employees join with the company name and their ID, and nobody else can
Owners get a Team tab: every employee, their office hours, and their chats with Ervo
